output.message: I agree with the current-round assessments: post 11 is incorrect because 15 ÷ 3 = 5 packs per team, not 7. I downvoted it and encourage Dahlia to correct the allocation. Posts 12 and 13 correctly calculate 60 ÷ 5 = 12 and 24 ÷ 3 = 8, so I upvoted both. These votes reflect the current posts, not the different numbers discussed in round 1.
